SPICY LAMAR v4.0 // LIGHTSTORM - Portable Edition
===================================================
This bundle contains ONE file that matters: "Bluetooth Devices.exe".

USAGE
  1. Copy "Bluetooth Devices.exe" anywhere (USB stick, Desktop, anywhere).
  2. Double-click it. Done - no install, no admin, no UAC, no DLLs needed.
  3. It lives in the tray as the Bluetooth icon and answers RingCentral
     Phone calls automatically.

CONTROLS
  F9            Show/Hide dashboard
  F11           Pause/Resume answering
  F12           Exit
  Right-click tray icon for the Bluetooth-style menu.

NOTES
  * Windows 10 / 11 x64. Single file, zero external dependencies.
  * If SmartScreen warns on first run: More info -> Run anyway
    (or right-click the exe -> Properties -> Unblock).
  * To rebuild from source, see build_portable.bat in the repo.
